articles.title: Uppgifter: USA ska höja tullar
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Uppgifter: USA ska höja tullar
articles.body_text: USA ska enligt uppgifter till Wall Street Journal vara på gång med nya tullar. Arkivbild. USA och president Donald Trump förbereder ett nytt tullpaket mot bland annat EU, Kina och ett antal andra länder. Detta enligt uppgifter till Wall Street Journal. De nya tullarna ska enligt tidningen omfatta merparten av importerade varor från berörda länder. Däremot undantas stål, aluminium och fordon då dessa redan omfattas av tullarna. Enligt Wall Street Journal är de slutgiltiga tullnivåerna inte fastställda. EU, Japan och Sydkorea ska dock få tullar på högst 15 procent medan Kina väntas få högre tullar än övriga länder.

articles.title: Källor: 20 miljarder kronor saknas för Stegra
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Källor: 20 miljarder kronor saknas för Stegra
articles.body_text: Leif Johansson, ny styrelseordförande för Stegra, under en pressträff i april. Källor: 20 miljarder kronor saknas för Stegra Ståltillverkaren Stegra behöver få in ytterligare minst 2 miljarder dollar, motsvarande över 20 miljarder svenska kronor, i nytt kapital. Det uppger nyhetsbyrån Bloomberg och hänvisar till källor insatta i ärendet. Tidigare under hösten har det rapporterats av bland annat Affärsvärlden att stålprojektet i Boden behöver ta in ytterligare kapital för att färdigställa fabriken i Boden. Detta trots att Wallenbergsfären under våren gått in som ägare i bolaget och skjutit till nya pengar. Stegra ville då inte kommentera tidningens uppgifter om summan 10 miljarder kronor, men som ändå delvis bekräftades av styrelseordförande Leif Johansson som “lite flytande materia”. Jag skulle ju tro att det kommer att behövas lite mer kapital och det kommer att behövas olika sorters insatser ifrån företaget, sade Johansson till TT då. Stegra, som tidigare hette H2 Green Steel, grundades 2020 med målet att producera så kallat grönt stål, det vill säga utifrån fossilfria produktionsmetoder.

articles.title: Trump lägger ut bh-bild på Huang
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Trump lägger ut bh-bild på Huang
articles.body_text: Jensen Huang tar emot en utmärkelse av Donald Trump i samband med ett evenemang i Washington den 8 oktober. Donald Trump har lagt ut en fejkad bild på Nvidias Jensen Huang hållande en röd bh. Bilden publiceras timmar efter att vd:n gjort oväntad comeback efter otrohetsskandalen. På bilden har Huang blod på kinden och knuten näve. Den liknar bilden som togs av Trump efter mordförsöket i Butler i Pennsylvania 2024 och väcker uppmärksamhet i USA och världen. Halvledarjätten Nvidias styrelse återinsatte Jensen Huang som vd i måndags. Han sparkades nyligen efter att flera otrohetsskandaler uppdagats, varav en med en misstänkt kinesisk spion. Trump har försvarat Huang och säger att det är tack vare honom vd:n återanställs. Exakt vad Trump vill säga med bilden är oklart, men han hävdar att händelserna inte skadar Huangs anseende. Sex säljer, grabbar, säger han till CNBC . Kongressens demokrater har lovat utreda Nvidiaaffären när de tar över makten i januari.

articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Nvidia faller – Anthropic under teckningskurs
articles.body_text: Nvidia faller – Anthropic under teckningskurs Efter måndagens kraftiga kursrusning backar Nvidias aktie tillbaka 5 procent i tisdagens förhandel. AI-jätten Anthropic faller också kraftigt, ner under teckningskursen 83 dollar. I stort sett alla amerikanska techjättar faller i den amerikanska terminshandeln inför öppningen i den ordinarie handeln på USA-börserna i eftermiddag. Tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex ligger vid lunchtid på minus 1,7 procent i förhandeln. Utvecklingen sker efter att Nvidia rusat drygt 31 procent på beskedet att Jensen Huang gör comeback som vd. Nyheten fick hela den amerikanska techsektorn att lyfta och Nasdaqs kompositindex hade vid stängning på måndagskvällen rusat 6,5 procent. USA-börserna öppnar för handel klockan 15.30 i eftermiddag.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Syria land mine casualties soar, two years after war
articles.summary: Nearly 1,000 children are among those killed or injured by explosives left over from the conflict, figures show.
articles.body_text: Eleven-year-old Alaa was tending her family's goats with her siblings in a field behind their home in Umm Khuzaym, north-west Syria, on Sunday when there was a flash and a deafening bang. "Then we heard people screaming," Alaa's father, Walid Mohammed Al-Ghafar, told the BBC. Walid ran outside to find his daughter lying face down, lifeless, and her 10-year-old brother, Mahmoud, seriously injured. Unwittingly, the children had triggered a landmine. The incident and others this week bring to nearly 1,000 the number of children killed or injured by explosive ordnance in Syria since the fall of Bashar al-Assad in December 2024, according to the UN Mine Action Service (Unmas). The village is one of many where families have returned to homes and farmland that were once on the front lines of Syria's 13-year civil war. Alaa's father said demining teams had visited several times to clear the fields. He and other residents believed it was safe for farmers and children to move around. But mines and other explosives can lie far beyond former battle lines, making it difficult to establish which areas are safe. "Remnants of war from today's conflicts are often very widely and broadly scattered, often without patterns, which makes it extremely difficult to do clearance," Katrin Atkins, research lead at Landmine Monitor, a global mine monitoring initiative, told the BBC. The dangers are reflected in a sharp rise in casualties across Syria. A total of 1,602 people were killed or injured by landmines and explosive remnants of war in 2025 alone, an increase of more than 50% on the previous year, according to the Landmine Monitor report, published by the International Campaign to Ban Landmines on Tuesday. Only Myanmar, with 1,891 casualties, recorded more.

articles.title: Russian governor detained in rare criminal case against regional leader
articles.summary: Andrei Chibis, head of Russia's northern Murmansk region, is the first governor to be detained for five years.
articles.body_text: The governor of Russia's northern Murmansk region has been arrested on corruption charges in the first detention of a regional leader for five years. Andrei Chibis, 47, is suspected of embezzlement and misappropriation of more than a billion roubles ($12.2.m; £9.3m) set aside to build an Arctic highway, as well as a further 39m roubles from the Murmansk construction budget. Chibis is reported to have been detained as he arrived on a visit to Moscow on Monday and was taken in for questioning. He denies wrongdoing but has made no public comment. His wife Yevgenia Chibis said "anyone who knows our family understands how ridiculous this is". In a post on social media, she said her husband sincerely believed in the Murmansk region and thanked people for their words of support: "We really need them right now." Chibis worked for several years as deputy minister for construction and housing, before becoming governor of Murmansk in 2019. Murmansk is a key military point for Russia in the Arctic and is home to the Russian navy's Northern fleet. Chibis was re-elected two years ago after surviving a knife attack and is considered an active supporter of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Governors are seen as representing the Kremlin, and Vladimir Putin removed several in the months after the war began in February 2022. However, until now no regional governor has been arrested since the start of the war, even though plenty of high-ranking officials have been detained in that time. The Murmansk governor is one of a number of officials suspected of corruption by the Russian interior ministry's investigative department which, according to reports, alleged that a criminal group was set up in 2022 to embezzle money from the regional budget and move it abroad, including to Kyrgyzstan. Another part of the case involves alleged fraud surrounding the rebuilding of a motorway between the two Arctic towns of Apatity and Kirovsk, which are 15km (9.3 miles) apart. According to Russian news agency Interfax, a court will decide whether Chibis will remain in custody at a hearing on Wednesday.

articles.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
articles.summary: Naeem Abu Nahel, who had only been in the position for two months, was targeted in western Gaza City, Gaza's interior ministry says.
articles.body_text: An Israeli air strike has killed the head of Hamas's internal security service in Gaza. Gaza's Hamas-run interior ministry said Naeem Abu Nahel was targeted by an aircraft in western Gaza City. The 50-year-old had only been in the position since September, when his predecessor was captured in a raid by Israeli special forces . Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defence Minister Israel Katz announced that Abu Nahel had been "eliminated" by the Israeli military. Earlier, Palestinian first responders and health officials reported that six other people had been killed in two Israeli air strikes elsewhere in Gaza on Tuesday. Three people, including a teenage boy, were killed in the Wadi Gaza area, south of Gaza City, they said. The other three, including two police officers, were killed in a separate strike on a police station in the al-Mawasi area, west of Khan Younis, they added. Gaza's police force, which operates under the interior ministry, condemned the second attack, saying it was "part of an ongoing campaign targeting the police apparatus aimed at sowing chaos" in the territory. The Israeli military said it had "struck terrorists in the area". Israeli strikes on Gaza take place almost daily despite a US-brokered ceasefire agreed by Israel and Hamas in October last year. At least 1,679 people have been killed in Gaza since then, according to the territory's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Israel says six of its soldiers have been killed in Gaza over the same period. The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Since then, more than 74,740 people have been killed in Israeli attacks in Gaza, the health ministry says.

articles.title: Villavicencio car bomb: More than 20 injured in attack in Colombian city
articles.summary: The explosion is the latest in a string of attacks on buildings housing the security forces and government offices.
articles.body_text: A car bomb has exploded in the central Colombian city of Villavicencio, injuring at least 23 people. The explosive device was detonated in front of the offices of the regional government, in the city centre, damaging several buildings. No group has so far admitted carrying out the attack - the latest in a series using explosives to target official buildings and security forces' headquarters. Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella blamed "narcoterrorism", but gave no details. Armed criminal groups have recently stepped up attacks in what appears to be retaliation for an offensive ordered against them by De la Espriella. Writing on social media, the president said that his government would "bluntly and forcefully" respond to "every drop of Colombian blood spilled". "There will be no impunity and no retreat," he added. Three weeks ago, three adults and a baby were killed in a car bomb attack near army barracks in Tolima province . And earlier on Monday, drones dropped explosives on the police headquarters in the northern city of Cúcuta. The car bomb in Villavicencio went off on Monday evening - the eve of the 10th anniversary of the signing of a peace deal between the government and left-wing rebels of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (Farc), Colombia's largest guerrilla group. Following the signing of the deal, thousands of left-wing rebel fighters laid down their arms. However, a significant number of Farc members, who did not agree with the deal, refused to disarm and joined dissident groups instead. While forced displacement, child recruitment and the numbers of attacks on security forces dropped in the aftermath of the deal, there has been an upsurge in recent years driven by dissident Farc factions and criminal groups fighting for control of drug trafficking, illegal mining and extortion rackets.

articles.title: Pope Francis' diary reveals claims he saw the devil three times
articles.summary: Published extracts from the late pontiff's diary claim one of the visions happened "in the choir loft" during Mass.
articles.body_text: Pope Francis claimed he saw the devil three times over the course of his life, as well as the "gates of hell", according to new extracts from his private diary. In The Private Diary of Pope Francis, published on Tuesday, a 2021 entry lists the late pontiff as having three visions of the devil: once from a car, another "in the choir loft" during Mass, and a third during a meeting with Vatican officials. "I can't forget the powerful raspiness of his voice," Francis wrote, recalling one of the visions. In the diary, written from 1992 to 2024, he also expresses regret over his 2018 visit to Chile, when he was criticised for defending a bishop who was accused of covering up sexual abuse committed by a priest. Francis, who led the Catholic Church for 12 years until his death in 2025, later apologised and summoned the country's bishops to Rome, where they all offered to resign . "Devastated because of the situation in Chile," Francis wrote in a 2021 entry. "It was hard for me to admit what happened in Chile; I didn't think it was so serious." Of his encounters, which Francis interpreted as meetings with the devil, he said he could not forget the devil's "menacing" eyes. "He looked at me with flaming eyes... more intense than the previous one. They were like flashes of fire," he wrote of his second vision that he said happened inside a Carmelite chapel while he was archbishop of Buenos Aires. He said the devil's presence intruded on his journeys, including during the visit to Chile amid the clerical sexual abuse scandal, and a meeting a few days after he had returned to Rome. "I saw him and heard his voice, triumphant, possessing everything," he wrote, adding that "the Lord gave me the chance to free myself from these encounters". The late pope also revealed that while getting ready to go to sleep in June 2018, he "saw the gates of hell".

articles.title: Watch: Moment troops raid home and capture Mexican drug lord
articles.summary: Newly-released bodycam footage shows the moment troops detained 'El Chapo Isidro', who had managed to evade capture for years.
articles.body_text: Newly-released bodycam footage shows the moment troops entered a house and detained a Mexican drug lord who had managed to evade capture for years. The video shows armed personnel entering via a garage and finding Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, also known as 'El Chapo Isidro', who was on the FBI's most wanted list. Seven suspects were killed in last Friday's operation, as were four members of the Mexican army who were travelling to reinforce security in Guasave, Mexico's defence secretariat said. The arrest of Meza Flores in the northern Sinaloa state sparked a wave of unrest, which led to eight alleged drug cartel members being detained for their involvement in the retaliatory violence. The Pope took to the skies before arriving in Cusco on the penultimate day of his Latin America tour. Pope Leo XIV celebrated a huge Mass for hundreds of thousands of pilgrims in Chiclayo, where he once served as bishop. The Pope celebrated an outdoor Mass in Argentina's capital, the second stop on a 12-day tour of Latin America, just three weeks after having had surgery for lung cancer. King Charles III and Queen Camilla were standing in an open-air stadium when the rain came on. Sources have told the BBC that the defeated presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro is in the US, hours after Brazil cancelled his passports. The WhatsApp channel called "Lula's Army" gathered almost 11 million people and was led by Congressman André Janones, whom Lula thanked during his victory speech. The Venezuelan opposition leader spent more than 10 months in exile after escaping the country on a speedboat. Brazil's left-wing President has been elected for a fourth term after narrowly beating right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro in a knife-edge vote.

articles.title: DR Congo conflict: Army seeks missing aircraft as FRN rebels claim to shoot down plane
articles.summary: A South African fighter pilot and a Ugandan officer are reportedly among those aboard the downed plane.
articles.body_text: The Democratic Republic of Congo military says it is searching for one of its aircraft, after rebels said they had shot down a warplane in the east. The military said it had lost contact with a small Cessna 208 cargo plane on Sunday following "poor weather conditions". The fate of the plane and its crew remained uncertain, it added. On the same day, the rebel Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN) said it had shot down a warplane that was on a mission to bomb Minembwe in South Kivu province. Four people were reportedly on board, including a Ugandan and a South African pilot, who is said to have been captured alive. The BBC has not independently verified the rebels' claim. It is also unclear whether the aircraft reported missing by the DR Congo military is the same one rebels say they shot down. Uganda's military on Monday denied any involvement. A statement attributed to army chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba posted on X said: "UPDF had nothing to do with the aircraft that was shot down in Minembwe. We have penalized that company." The statement did not identify the company or explain what penalty had been imposed. Gen Kainerugaba later posted that "no Ugandan is allowed to work for mercenary companies in [DR Congo]". Uganda's denial followed the circulation of a video apparently showing a man being questioned beside the plane's wreckage. In the footage, the man identifies himself as Ugandan and claims he had been sent by the government. The BBC has not independently verified the video or established the man's identity.

articles.title: What Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia teaches China's Xi about Trump
articles.summary: Huang being back at the helm of Nvidia is no guarantee of relief for Beijing.
articles.body_text: Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO has riveted the world - including China, where it has become the top trending post on Weibo, the country's biggest social media platform. Most users are pleased to see the return of the influential billionaire, who declared that he loved China, before videos appeared online of him eating noodles and drinking milk tea during a visit in May. Some wondered why - in the video of him returning to Nvidia's headquarters - he is not wearing one of his leather jackets. But to many, Huang's return, which is being dubbed one of the greatest U-turns of all time, seems like a vindication for China. That's probably how Xi Jinping sees it too. Beijing has dismissed claims that one of the women who had an affair with Jensen Huang had been recruited by China's Ministry of State Security, its version of the CIA, as a spy. Chinese state media has also framed the spy saga as a smear campaign orchestrated by China hawks in Washington. The Global Times, a Communist Party mouthpiece, described it as a "witch hunt". Now the White House, and President Donald Trump himself, have said Huang poses no national security threat, although investigations into the spy allegations are still ongoing. Xi will have learned many lessons from this scandal, especially about Trump's pressure points. For one, the fact that Huang's reappointment came so soon after Xi's meetings last week with Trump in Shenzhen could be read as a sign that direct engagement is an effective way to influence Washington. Trump has said the two men discussed Huang, but did not elaborate further. Beijing has not commented. The episode has also reinforced the view among Chinese officials that there are two camps in Washington: those in favour of restricting Chinese access to cutting edge tech to protect US national security, and those, like Huang, who believe that such restrictions will not limit Beijing's ambitions. Huang has repeatedly argued that US export controls will force Chinese firms like Huawei to build independent alternatives - all the while shutting American companies out of the world's second-largest economy. But him being back at the helm of Nvidia is no guarantee of relief for Beijing.

articles.title: Saurav Das: Cockroach Janta Party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK for Oxford event
articles.summary: Saurav Das said that immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him that his passport had been "flagged".
articles.body_text: A leader of India's "cockroach" party has said that immigration officials at Delhi airport stopped him from flying to the UK, where he was set to attend a series of events. Saurav Das said he was supposed to board a flight on Tuesday at 01:00 local time (19:30 GMT on Monday) but was told by immigration officers that his passport had been "flagged". It is not clear yet why Das's passport was flagged. The BBC has reached out to the federal home ministry, Delhi police and airport officials for comment. Das, who rose to prominence in India earlier this year after Gen Z-led protests , said that he had been invited by the Oxford Union to speak about the movement. He said that he was also scheduled to speak at other universities in Cambridge and Edinburgh. "Indian students put their heart and soul to organise the events but this anti-intellectual [government] was scared of me going to these prestigious institutions," Das wrote on X. A federal home ministry spokesperson directed the BBC to airport authorities and the Delhi police for comment on Das's allegations. On Tuesday, the London School of Economics Student Union's Amnesty International Unit, a student-led charity group, shared a post on Instagram saying that an event featuring Das had been "indefinitely postponed". Ratna Singh, another leader of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), said in a post on X that she and Das had been invited by the Oxford Union but that her visa had been rejected a few days ago. "The manner in which Saurav was not allowed to board today raises deeply troubling questions about the state of freedom of expression and the space being allowed for young voices in this country," she wrote. Das, a former journalist, became one of the faces of the CJP - a Gen Z-led movement that began as satire but has since emerged as a youth-led pressure group. In July, protests spearheaded by the CJP over exam paper leaks led to the resignation of India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan .

articles.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
articles.summary: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.
articles.body_text: Nato chief Mark Rutte has said the alliance will defend against any threats in space after German reports that Russia is preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite. Intelligence reports about a possible launch in the next 60 days had been shared among Nato countries this month, according to German media. It was not clear which country had authored the reports. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said such reports were "not new, yet they remain no less shocking", and a government spokesman said the reports were being taken "very seriously". Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said he had not seen the reports but dismissed stories citing "unknown sources" as "hardly worth taking seriously". The Russian embassy in Berlin told German media it rejected what it called "unfounded allegations" and said the reports were part of a "propaganda campaign". Citing anonymous German military and intelligence sources, public broadcasters NDR and WDR and newspaper Süddeutscher Zeitung, said the Russian satellite was dubbed "Sputnik-S" and was equipped with a nuclear warhead. It could be used to disrupt or destroy other satellites, including important communication and observation satellites. Asked about the reports, the Nato secretary general told a press conference in Berlin alongside Merz: "We will always make sure we defend every inch of Nato territory, and that includes making sure we are safe when it comes to the space element." The Western defensive alliance had a variety of response options, said Rutte. "When it comes to the military domain, we will always make assessments of our deterrence and defence and make updates where necessary." Merz did not confirm or deny the reports of Russia's plans, but said they "reveal the level of escalation Russia is evidently prepared to pursue". German government spokesman Stefan Kornelius warned against causing "excessive nervousness regarding hypothetical dangers". Josef Aschbacher, the head of the European Space Agency, told the Handeslblatt newspaper that having nuclear weapons in space was "the ultimate nightmare scenario".

articles.title: Cheers and applause as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia office
articles.summary: BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return after Trump says he brokered a deal.
articles.body_text: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and president on Monday. President Trump has claimed credit for brokering the deal. What is the mood at Nvidia following the announcement? BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return. BBC Weather's Elizabeth Rizzini looks at the weather that will impact travel over US Thanksgiving. The BBC's Samira Hussain breaks down the AI company's first day as a publicly traded company, as shares closed up 17%. The sale comes after an eleventh-hour agreement was reached to resolve a dispute regarding claims the art piece was previously sold under duress during the rise of the Nazis. The BBC's Samira Hussain speaks to a retail investor eagerly waiting for the AI company's stock to go live on Thursday. The vehicles currently operate in 15 US cities, though freeway rides are only offered in a handful, including San Francisco and Los Angeles. Entire neighbourhoods remain under water as disruptions impact schools, roads, hospitals and airports. A drilling operation at the Chiquita Canyon Landfill triggered a large release of gas and decomposing waste that neighbours are voicing concerns over. The 40-year-old British actor will take over from Daniel Craig in the next 007 film as fans and enthusiasts react to the news. Rescuers found the pet cat in the ruins of Zariah's apartment four days after she made an emotional plea to the public. US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin also said that there should be 'no fear' and that 'everyone is safe' when discussing a nationwide air traffic outage.

articles.title: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book
articles.summary: The publisher of an essay on coercive control apologises for "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".
articles.body_text: Gisèle Pelicot has said she has been "once again humiliated" after nude images of her were sent to the media to promote a book about coercive control. The 73-year-old told French broadcaster BFM TV she would take legal action against the publisher and author of the essay. Pelicot made headlines across the world when she waived her right to anonymity in the trial of her then-husband Dominique, who was jailed for 20 years for drugging and raping her, as well as allowing other men to rape her while she was unconscious. The publisher apologised, saying it would no longer print or promote the work after "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication". Pelicot told BFM: "I am deeply shocked that images from the most intimate part of my private life are being displayed and exploited for commercial purposes." "Today I find myself once again humiliated, exposed and hurt, as if the ordeal of the trial had not been enough," she said. The essay was written by Sabine Prokhoris, a philosopher and psychoanalyst, who has previously criticised the Me Too movement. French media reported that Tinbad, a small Paris publishing house, emailed nude photos of Pelicot taken by her ex-husband to some media outlets in order to promote the essay. In a statement on its website, Tinbad said that no further print runs of the book would be produced beyond the 280 copies already in circulation. "We offer our sincerest apologies to Ms Gisèle Pelicot," it said. The company also apologised to the author. Tinbad said "no images of rape or pornographic videos" were sent to the media. French news agency AFP quoted the blurb of the book as saying coercive control was "a cornerstone of #MeToo orthodoxy".

articles.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
articles.summary: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.
articles.body_text: A prominent singer who performed without the mandatory hijab and four members of her band and production team have been flogged by Iranian authorities, lawyers say. Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were each given 74 lashes in the city of Qom, a member of their defence team told the BBC. Ahmadi, 29, wore a sleeveless dress during a concert that was livestreamed in December 2024. Iran's laws ban public performances by women and require them to wear headscarves and modest clothing. This June, a criminal court in Qom convicted Ahmadi and eight others of "offending public decency" through the publication of "obscene and indecent material", which they had denied. In addition to being sentenced to 74 lashes, they were banned from audiovisual activities and from leaving the country for two years. At the end of September, an appeals court in Qom rejected the defendants' appeal and confirmed the sentence, her lawyers said. There was widespread condemnation of the sentences from other Iranian artists and human rights activists, who warned that flogging constituted cruel, inhuman and degrading punishment, and violated the international prohibition on torture. On Monday, one of the defendants' lawyers told the BBC that Ahmadi and four of her male co-defendants had been flogged at the third branch of the Criminal Sentence Enforcement Office in Qom. "We did everything in our power to have the verdict overturned, or at least to secure a reduction in the sentence or a suspension, but it didn't work out," he said. "The other lawyers and I even tried to get the enforcement of the sentence postponed, but the enforcement branch insisted on carrying it out immediately." Pro-reform daily Etemad cited another defence lawyer, Mostafa Nili, as identifying the four men flogged alongside Ahmadi as Soheil Faghih-Nasiri, Amin Taheri, Amirali Pirnia and Mohsen Lashkari. "Parastoo Ahmadi's flogging for singing and dressing as she chooses is a flagrant violation of her fundamental rights and a chilling demonstration of the Iranian authorities' determination to suppress women's freedoms and to violently punish anyone who dares to challenge their discriminatory laws and policies," said Bahar Ghandehari, director of advocacy at the US-based Center for Human Rights in Iran (CHRI).

articles.title: Trump faces backlash after he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
articles.summary: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.
articles.body_text: Jensen Huang has been reinstated as the boss of Nvidia less than two weeks after he was forced to resign following the revelations of extra marital affairs, one of which was with a suspected Chinese spy. The AI chipmaker handed its co-founder his job back, despite rejecting his initial offer to return, after pressure from US President Donald Trump. Trump said he "made the deal" with the tech giant's board to get Huang his job back, but both the president and Nvidia are facing backlash from lawmakers. But his comeback added almost $1 trillion to Nvidia's market value as its share price jumped 31%, ending ended a streak of losses on the US stock market. Nvidia's gains helped boost shares in other tech companies and financial markets in Asia while European markets were flat. However, despite Huang's return, Nvidia's share price remains down over the past month amid investor concerns about the wider AI industry and future development. But it is a dramatic return for the man dubbed the "Taylor Swift of tech" to the company at the centre of the AI spending boom. Attention will soon turn to Huang's appearance before Congress next week, where the Nvidia boss will be questioned over his relationship with Alice Huang, alleged to be a spy for China, due to national security concerns. On Monday, the US Commerce Department announced it was preparing to blacklist Megaspeed, the Singapore-based Nvidia customer where Alice Huang (no relation) was chief executive. China has denied the spying allegations. Harvey Jones, chairman of Nvidia's board, said Huang's reinstatement after originally resigning on 12 November was in the "best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers". The board said it had received input from senior levels of the US government and was confident that Huang's reinstatement posed no national security risk. Last Tuesday, the board explicitly said it did not intend to reinstate him following calls to do so and Huang himself stating he would be open to returning.

articles.title: The Jacksons suspende su concierto en Perú y anuncia devolución de entradas
articles.summary: La agrupación no realizará el concierto previsto en Costa 21, según informó Sound Music Entertainment.
articles.body_text: El concierto de The Jacksons en Lima, prevista para el próximo 15 de diciembre de 2026 en Costa 21, fue suspendida, según informó la empresa organizadora Sound Music Entertainment. Según explicaron, no llegaron a “un acuerdo que permita continuar con el evento”. “Desde el inicio de este proyecto, nuestra compañía asumió el compromiso de traer al Perú a una de las agrupaciones más emblemáticas de la historia de la música internacional, realizando importantes esfuerzos de planificación, coordinación y gestión para ofrecer un espectáculo a la altura de las expectativas de nuestro público”, señaló la organización a través de un comunicado. Sobre las conversaciones que se desarrollaron para intentar mantener el evento en la fecha prevista, Sound Music Entertainment indicó que evaluó distintas posibilidades junto con los representantes de la agrupación. “Durante las últimas conversaciones, mantuvimos nuestra disposición de encontrar alternativas que permitieran preservar la realización del espectáculo. Sin embargo, lamentablemente, no ha sido posible alcanzar un acuerdo que permita continuar con el evento”, precisó la empresa. Tras conocerse la cancelación del concierto en Costa 21, la empresa realizadora también se disculpó con los fans que adquirieron sus entradas y que, con mucha ilusión, esperaban ver a The Jacksons en Lima. En cuanto al reembolso de las entradas de The Jacksons, la productora informó que las compras efectuadas mediante la página web tendrán una devolución automática al titular de la transacción, utilizando el mismo medio de pago empleado durante la adquisición. Por su parte, quienes compraron sus boletos de manera presencial deberán ingresar a la plataforma de Teleticket y registrar sus datos mediante la opción Soporte Fans. La empresa precisó que las devoluciones comenzarán a realizarse desde el miércoles 2 de diciembre de 2026.

articles.title: ¡Todo consumado! El TAS decide otorgar a Senegal el título de campeón de la Copa Africana de Naciones 2025
articles.summary: El Tribunal Arbitral del Deportes decidió por unanimidad darle el trofeo a Senegal y no a Marruecos, que había obtenido el título en los despachos.
articles.body_text: Senegal fue ratificado como campeón de la Copa África de Naciones luego de que el Tribunal de Arbitraje Deportivo (TAS) resolviera a su favor la apelación presentada contra la Confederación Africana de Fútbol (CAF). El organismo dejó sin efecto la resolución que había otorgado el título a Marruecos por 3-0 en los despachos y reconoció nuevamente el triunfo senegalés en la final. La controversia se originó el 18 de enero, durante el partido disputado en Rabat. En los minutos finales del tiempo reglamentario, varios futbolistas de Senegal abandonaron el campo después de que el árbitro cobrara un penal a favor de Marruecos. El capitán Sadio Mané permaneció en el terreno de juego y, tras unos minutos de tensión, sus compañeros regresaron para continuar el encuentro. En el lanzamiento desde los doce pasos, Brahim Díaz falló la oportunidad de darle el título a Marruecos. La definición se extendió hasta la prórroga, donde Pape Gueye marcó el tanto que permitió a Senegal imponerse por 1-0 y levantar el trofeo. Sin embargo, en marzo, el Comité de Apelación de la CAF modificó el resultado y declaró ganador al conjunto marroquí por 3-0. Tras revisar el caso, el panel arbitral del TAS consideró que la decisión de continuar el encuentro correspondía exclusivamente al árbitro. Según el organismo, cuando el partido se reanudó, ambos equipos estaban nuevamente en el campo y habían manifestado su disposición para jugar. Por ello, concluyó que no existió un error de derecho en la actuación del juez. En su resolución, el tribunal explicó que los artículos 82 y 84 del reglamento de la Copa África no podían aplicarse a esta situación, pues contemplan escenarios en los que el comportamiento de un equipo provoca la suspensión definitiva del partido. “En conclusión, la Formación Arbitral considera que, al reanudar el encuentro, el árbitro no incurrió en ningún error de derecho”, señaló el TAS. También descartó que su decisión hubiera sido arbitraria, pese al ambiente de tensión que se vivió durante la final. Con este fallo, Senegal conserva oficialmente el campeonato que había conseguido en la cancha y Marruecos pierde el reconocimiento que le había otorgado la CAF. El TAS también precisó que las sanciones disciplinarias impuestas previamente a la Federación Senegalesa, al entrenador Pape Thiaw y a determinados jugadores corresponden a procedimientos independientes y no fueron objeto de modificación en esta resolución.

articles.title: ¿A qué hora ver la final del Miss Universo 2026 EN VIVO hoy 24 de noviembre en EE.UU.?
articles.summary: Revisa los horarios en Estados Unidos para ver la final del Miss Universo 2026, que se realizará hoy martes 24 de noviembre en Puerto Rico.
articles.body_text: Este martes 24 de noviembre de 2026, el emblemático Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot, en San Juan, albergará la esperada gala final de Miss Universo 2026. Se trata de una cita verdaderamente histórica, ya que el certamen conmemora su 75.ª edición, celebrando tres cuartos de siglo de trayectoria como la plataforma de belleza más influyente del planeta. En esta noche de aniversario, 116 candidatas de distintos países y territorios competirán por conquistar la corona El Resplandor de un Legado Eterno y suceder a la mexicana Fátima Bosch. Entre las aspirantes que más atención acaparan destaca la representante de Estados Unidos, Justus Kelley, una filántropa y especialista en salud pública de 31 años originaria de Virginia. La miss USA resaltó en las ediciones previas del certamen y cuenta con el aliento de sus seguidores para lograr la corona. articles.summary: El precio del dólar inició la jornada de este martes en S/3,469 en el mercado cambiario peruano, por encima de los S/3,458 del cierre anterior, con un avance de 0.32%.
articles.body_text: El precio del dólar inició la jornada de este martes en S/3,469 en el mercado cambiario peruano, por encima de los S/3,458 del cierre anterior, con un avance de 0,32%. La moneda estadounidense ganó terreno frente al sol en un contexto de caída de los precios de los metales y cautela en los mercados internacionales, pese al ligero retroceso del dólar a nivel global. Según Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista, la debilidad del cobre continúa generando presión sobre el sol peruano, mientras los mercados anticipan un posible incremento de 25 puntos básicos en las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal (Fed) en diciembre. La publicación del indicador de inflación PCE de Estados Unidos será clave para evaluar las perspectivas de política monetaria. En los mercados internacionales, el Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) se ubica alrededor de los 103.93 puntos, mientras el cobre, el oro y la plata registran pérdidas. Asimismo, las acciones de Nvidia retrocedieron cerca de 5% en las operaciones previas a la apertura del mercado estadounidense, ante las dudas sobre las valorizaciones y la rentabilidad de las inversiones en inteligencia artificial. Por su parte, el petróleo Brent y el WTI recuperaron parte del terreno perdido tras alcanzar mínimos de tres meses. En el ámbito local, la economía peruana creció 3,1% interanual durante el tercer trimestre de 2026, impulsada por el dinamismo de la demanda interna, que avanzó 6,1%, y la inversión privada. Asimismo, las inversiones mineras acumuladas alcanzaron US$5.522.5 millones. Si bien estos resultados representan un respaldo para los fundamentos económicos del país, el retroceso del cobre continúa siendo un factor de presión sobre la moneda nacional. De cara al cierre de la sesión, el análisis de Kambista señala que la evolución del tipo de cambio estará condicionada por el comportamiento de los metales y las expectativas sobre los próximos indicadores económicos de Estados Unidos. En Perú, la atención también estará centrada en las operaciones del Banco Central de Reserva (BCR), ante los vencimientos de swaps cambiarios de compra por S/400 millones y certificados de depósito por S/1.098.5 millones, cuya eventual renovación podría influir en las condiciones del mercado interbancario.

articles.title: Arabia Saudita: un proyectil impacta contra una de las torres del Centro Financiero de Riad
articles.summary: Un proyectil impactó contra una torre del Centro Financiero de Riad, en Arabia Saudita. Se esperan detalles sobre los daños y posibles víctimas.
articles.body_text: Un proyectil impactó este martes contra una de las torres del Centro Financiero Rey Abdullah de la capital de Arabia Saudita, Riad, donde se encuentra la sede del Fondo de Inversión Pública (PIF) del país árabe, sin que hasta el momento haya trascendido información sobre los daños en el edificio. La coalición militar liderada por Arabia Saudita que interviene en el Yemen desde 2015 informó en un breve comunicado de que “una de las torres del Centro Financiero fue objeto de un cobarde ataque terrorista”, terminología que utilizan a menudo para denunciar los lanzamientos de proyectiles de los rebeldes hutíes contra territorio saudita. Asimismo, añadió que las autoridades competentes “están inspeccionando actualmente el lugar del ataque”, sin informar de los daños ni si se han producido víctimas mortales o heridos. Hasta el momento, los hutíes -aliados de Irán- ni ningún otro grupo ha revindicado la acción, que se produce en medio de una intensificación de los ataques de los insurgentes del Yemen contra instalaciones civiles, económicas y energéticas de Arabia Saudita, que a su vez realiza bombardeos en territorio yemení. Esta no es la primera vez que un proyectil impacta contra el Centro Financiero de Riad, donde el pasado 19 de noviembre un ataque provocó daños materiales en varios pisos de una de las torres y en edificios adyacentes de este distrito, donde se encuentran las edificaciones más altas de la capital saudita. Los hutíes han intensificado sus acciones contra el reino árabe después de que la coalición bombardeara el fin de semana el puerto yemení de Al Hudeida, a orillas del mar Rojo, así como otras zonas del noroeste del Yemen bajo control de los rebeldes, que prometieron responder con dureza. Los insurgentes han reiterado en varias ocasiones que no hay ningún lugar seguro en Arabia Saudita a excepción de las regiones sagradas de La Meca y Medina, los lugares más importantes para los musulmanes y en los que la coalición afirma que los hutíes lanzan ataques, aunque el grupo lo niega. Esto se enmarca dentro de la nueva fase de la guerra del Yemen, que estalló en verano tras el bombardeo del aeropuerto de Saná -la capital del Yemen bajo control hutí-, un evento que dio inicio a una ofensiva de los rebeldes tanto en el propio país árabe como contra todo tipo de objetivos en Arabia Saudita.

articles.title: Colombia: De la Espriella visita Villavicencio, la ciudad que sufrió un grave atentado con 23 heridos
articles.summary: De la Espriella llegó a Villavicencio, donde un atentado dejó 23 heridos y reavivó las preocupaciones por la violencia en Colombia.
articles.body_text: El presidente colombiano, Abelardo de la Espriella, viaja este martes a la ciudad de Villavicencio (centro), donde anoche un atentado contra la Gobernación del departamento de Meta causó al menos 23 heridos, incluido un menor de edad, y graves daños materiales en los edificios adyacentes. El mandatario liderará un consejo de seguridad en el que participarán las Fuerzas Militares, la Policía y autoridades locales y regionales para tomar decisiones que permitan atender este ataque, achacado a un grupo de las disidencias de las Fuerzas Armadas Revolucionarias de Colombia (FARC) que lidera alias Antonio Medina. “Nuestra prioridad es evitar nuevos ataques, proteger la vida de nuestra gente, esclarecer lo ocurrido y garantizar que este atentado no quede impune”, aseguró anoche en X la gobernadora de Meta, Rafaela Cortés, tras conversar con el presidente. La explosión se produjo sobre las 21:30 hora local (02:30 GMT del martes) en la plaza de la Gobernación y las imágenes muestran fachadas arrancadas por la deflagración, techos levantados, ventanas rotas, un gran número de escombros por el suelo y un enorme cráter donde se apostó el vehículo bomba, todo en medio de una profunda oscuridad. El presidente tachó a los criminales que cometieron el atentado de “miserables y cobardes” y dijo que este ataque se debe a que “el narcoterrorismo está desesperado” por la “manera decidida” en que la Fuerza Pública lo está enfrentando desde que él llegó a la presidencia, hace cerca de cuatro meses. “Rechazo con firmeza el cobarde atentado terrorista contra la Gobernación del Meta. Toda mi solidaridad con los heridos, sus familias y el pueblo llanero. En el gobierno del Presidente De la Espriella no habrá impunidad. No vamos a retroceder”, expresó por su parte el vicepresidente colombiano, José Manuel Restrepo, en X. Justamente el sábado pasado, un bombardeo de las Fuerzas Militares contra el Frente 44 Antonio Ricaurte del Estado Mayor Central (EMC), la mayor disidencia de las FARC, en una zona rural del municipio de Mapiripán, en Meta, mató a cinco personas. Ómar Pardo Galeano, conocido como Antonio Medina, es el comandante del EMC en el convulso departamento de Arauca (este) y en el vecino Casanare y lideró en los últimos años un conflicto a muerte con la guerrilla del Ejército de Liberación Nacional (ELN) en esa región. Hoy hace dos años, el 24 de noviembre de 2024, la Jurisdicción Especial para la Paz (JEP) expulsó a este jefe de las disidencias de ese alto tribunal por seguir delinquiendo tras la firma del acuerdo de paz entre el Gobierno y las FARC hace 10 años. Antonio Medina es “un desertor armado manifiesto e incumplió con extrema gravedad las condiciones constitucionales y legales impuestas por el Sistema Integral de Justicia, Verdad, Reparación y No Repetición para acceder y mantener los beneficios instituidos” por el acuerdo de paz, detalló entonces la JEP.

articles.title: San Martín: condenan a 16 años de prisión a hombre por realizar tocamientos indebidos a adolescente
articles.summary: Wilbert Cenepo recibió 16 años de prisión efectiva por agredir sexualmente a una adolescente de 14 años en dos ocasiones, en la provincia de Picota, San Martín. El Poder Judicial también dispuso el pago de S/ 6.000 como reparación civil a favor de la víctima.
articles.body_text: Wilbert Cenepo fue condenado a 16 años de pena privativa de la libertad efectiva por el delito de tocamientos sin consentimiento en agravio de una adolescente de 14 años, en la provincia de Picota, región San Martín. El Juzgado Penal Colegiado Supraprovincial de Tarapoto también ordenó que el sentenciado pague S/6.000 como reparación civil a favor de la víctima. La sentencia fue obtenida por la Fiscalía Provincial Penal de Picota, que durante el juicio oral logró acreditar la responsabilidad penal del acusado. Según la investigación fiscal, Cenepo aprovechó su condición de conviviente de la tía de la menor para cometer las agresiones en dos oportunidades. El primer hecho ocurrió en 2022, cuando la adolescente pernoctaba en la vivienda de sus tíos. En esa ocasión, el acusado la agredió y se detuvo cuando se encendió la luz de la habitación. El segundo episodio se registró el 3 de setiembre de 2023, en el domicilio del sentenciado. La menor había acudido a visitar a su tía y se quedó a solas con Cenepo, quien la retuvo por la fuerza y la agredió sexualmente pese a su resistencia. La adolescente consiguió empujarlo y escapar del lugar. Tras lo ocurrido, la menor contó los hechos a su hermana y a su madre. Esta última confrontó al agresor y solicitó la intervención del área de Psicología del Centro de Salud de Pucacaca. Los profesionales del establecimiento comunicaron el caso a la Fiscalía, mientras que la familia presentó una denuncia ante la Comisaría de Picota. La intervención de los familiares y del personal de salud permitió activar las diligencias correspondientes y reunir los elementos de convicción que sustentaron la acusación fiscal y derivaron en la condena.

articles.body_text: Más de 250 hectáreas se incendiaron en las faldas del Chachani, uno de los tres volcanes que custodian la ciudad de Arequipa. De acuerdo al informe que dio el Centro de Operaciones de Emergencia Regional (COER) Arequipa, el fuego fue reportado a las 9:45 de la mañana del pasado sábado en la zona de Cabrerías en el distrito de Cayma. Pese al esfuerzo conjunto de los serenos de la municipalidad, brigadas del COER, INDECI, SERFOR y SERNANP, además de los bomberos y soldados de la Tercera División de Ejército, no se ha podido controlar el incendio que continúa expandiéndose por la ladera del volcán. El jefe del COER, José Antonio Carrera, indicó que actualmente las condiciones no favorecen el trabajo de extinción del fuego, por lo que acordaron continuar las labores en la madrugada de este martes para controlar y liquidar las llamas. “Estamos evaluando el impacto del incendio para solicitar ayuda a la Fuerza Aérea con un helicóptero”, indicó a El Comercio. El especialista en meteorología y climatología del Senamhi, José Luis Ticona, explicó a este medio que entre el 19 y 26 de noviembre las condiciones atmosféricas son propicias para la propagación de incendios forestales. En la zona del volcán Chachani, la temperatura llega a los 27 grados y los valores de humedad bajan hasta el 20 %. “Al ser una zona árida y seca, y con vientos de hasta 40 kilómetros por hora, es complicado poder controlar un incendio. En las madrugadas el viento baja a 20 kilómetros por hora”, agregó Ticona. Por su parte, el director del Instituto Nacional de Defensa Civil (INDECI - Arequipa), Carlos Nacarino, en entrevista con El Comercio, señaló que la gran dificultad es la falta de acceso al lugar del siniestro. No hay una vía. El fuego se expande por pendientes y quebradas peligrosas donde no pueden ingresar las brigadas, de ahí que insiste en el apoyo aéreo para apagar los puntos de calor. El jefe de la Compañía de Bomberos Arequipa, brigadier Juan Antonio Córdova, indicó a este medio que en caso de incendios forestales trabajan de manera diferente a los estructurales. Responsabilidad y daño. Esta emergencia que tiene en alerta a los ciudadanos en Arequipa habría sido provocada por personas irresponsables. El alcalde distrital de Cayma, Juan Carlos Linares, señaló ante los medios locales que durante una inspección en la zona encontró botellas de licor, ollas, cucharones, guantes y otros enseres. “Han venido hasta aquí, han hecho su fogata, han cocinado irresponsablemente. Esto tendrá que ser investigado por la policía”, declaró la autoridad local. El encargado de Incendios Forestales del Servicio Nacional Forestal y de Fauna Silvestre (SERFOR) en Arequipa, Álvaro Cárdenas, visitó la zona esta mañana y explicó a este medio que el incendio ha dañado flora y fauna de gran valor. Pastizales, Ichu, Tola, Pajonal Andino y Cactáceas. Pero lo que más les preocupa es que el fuego está llegando a la zona de los Queñuales, un bosque clave para la captación de agua declarado como vulnerable. “También se afectó la fauna, roedores, lagartijas, culebras y arañas. El incendio no solo ingresó a la zona de amortiguamiento de la Reserva Nacional de Salinas y Aguada Blanca, sino que está llegando a la zona núcleo, un espacio rico en biodiversidad donde hay pumas, vicuñas, huanacos, zorros. Se necesita que más personas apoyen y también helicópteros”, dijo a El Comercio, Álvaro Cárdenas. El especialista de la Organización de Gestión de Destino (OGD) del Valle de los Volcanes en Arequipa, Mateo Lira, califica como una tragedia el incendio en el Chachani. En conversación con El Comercio, señaló que la zona afectada por el incendio es un ecosistema de gran valor para Arequipa en términos ecológicos e hidrológicos. Las más de 250 hectáreas de matorral andino incineradas no solo representan la pérdida de vegetación, sino que también provocan la alteración de todo el sistema ecológico. Desapareció el sotobosque que protege el suelo, retiene humedad, aporta nutrientes y favorece la infiltración del agua. “Al desaparecer esta cobertura, aumenta la exposición del suelo a la radiación y al impacto de las lluvias. En el caso de los queñuales, aunque sobrevivan algunos árboles adultos, la pérdida de plántulas y juveniles puede comprometer la continuidad del bosque durante décadas. La degradación del suelo afecta su porosidad, estructura y capacidad de infiltrar y almacenar agua, alterando los procesos que contribuyen a la recarga de acuíferos. Se necesita evaluar qué especies y qué sectores fueron afectados, medir el estado del suelo, proteger las queñuas sobrevivientes, y, en general, recuperar el matorral nativo”, señaló Mateo Lira. Incendios en Arequipa El incendio que actualmente continúa activo en el volcán Chachani no es el único registrado en Arequipa. En junio hubo un incendio forestal en el distrito Yura, que ha sido catalogado como el más grande registrado históricamente en Arequipa. Se controló en cinco días y dañó más de mil hectáreas de ecosistema altoandino. El administrador técnico forestal y de fauna silvestre de SERFOR - Arequipa, Luis Felipe Gonzáles, explicó que el daño fue incalculable. De acuerdo al registro de la Gerencia Regional de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres, los incendios forestales son el segundo tipo de emergencias que se registra en la región, después de las lluvias intensas. En lo que va del año se han presentado 75 incendios en toda la región, siendo agosto (19), septiembre (15) y octubre (24) los meses con más eventos. Solo este 2026 se destruyeron 6,422.48 hectáreas en toda la región. De las ocho provincias, lidera la lista Arequipa con 2,259.01 hectáreas dañadas; le sigue La Unión con 2,008.35 hectáreas destrozadas. Luego está Caylloma con 1,173.23 hectáreas y después, Condesuyos y Castilla con 607.60 hectáreas y 372.29 hectáreas, respectivamente. El último en la lista es Caravelí con solo dos hectáreas afectadas. En el acumulado desde el 2020 hasta la fecha, se han registrado 1,337 incendios y el fuego arrasó con 45,506.03 hectáreas en toda la región. En el 2020 se reportaron 327 emergencias que afectaron 8,555.07 hectáreas y en 2021 fueron 316 incendios que dañaron 10,380.15 hectáreas. En el 2022 se registró la mayor cantidad de incendios forestales de los últimos seis años; fueron 413 que destrozaron 11,413.94 hectáreas. En el 2024 los siniestros descendieron a 107 incendios, afectando 3,834.61 hectáreas, mientras que en el 2025 fueron 99, con un daño de 4,900.39 hectáreas. El encargado de Incendios Forestales del SERFOR en Arequipa, Álvaro Cárdenas, aseguró que en todos los casos los incendios fueron provocados por personas irresponsables. Pese a la magnitud del daño, la fiscal Carolina Cáceres de la Fiscalía Provincial Especializada en Materia Ambiental (FEMA) de Arequipa, indicó a este medio que en su despacho solo hay tres casos que se investigan por incendios de bosques. Sobre el incendio en las faldas del volcán Chachani, señaló que “no es delito contra el medio ambiente”, porque en el lugar no se afectó a un bosque.

articles.title: Huang reportedly admitted to more than two affairs to Nvidia's board | TechCrunch
articles.summary: During a meeting before his reinstatement, Huang admitted to more affairs beyond the two that have been reported in the news, according to The Wall Street Journal.
articles.body_text: In a complete U-turn, Nvidia’s board on Monday reinstated Jensen Huang as the CEO and president of the chipmaker, just a fortnight after he resigned . During a meeting before his reinstatement, however, Huang admitted to more affairs beyond the two that have been reported in the news, according to The Wall Street Journal. Early in November, Huang admitted to an extramarital affair in a letter to employees. At the time, he was ostensibly talking about his relationship with Megaspeed executive and alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang (not related to Jensen). Later, it was reported that he’d also had a relationship with Nvidia’s VP of health, Kimberly Powell . Afterwards, Reuters reported that he also had an affair with another employee . It’s not clear which affairs Huang admitted to during this recent conversation with Nvidia’s board of directors. Huang’s return was spurred by a personal intervention from the U.S. government, Nvidia’s board said in a statement on Monday, and President Donald Trump apparently called the board to bat for Huang’s reinstatement . The Wall Street Journal reports that over the weekend, U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche told Trump and Vice President JD Vance that the Justice Department wasn’t investigating Huang and there was no evidence that he was a national security risk, after which both contacted the company’s board. Huang received a “hero’s welcome” at Nvidia’s HQ , with several employees applauding his return. Every weekday and Sunday, you can get the best of TechCrunch’s coverage. articles.title: Sennheiser Momentum 5 review: Great sound, incredible battery life, and few compromises | TechCrunch
articles.summary: I spent the last few weeks with the Sennheiser Momentum 5 to determine if this pair actually stands out, testing everything from sound quality and noise cancellation to comfort and battery life.
articles.body_text: There are a lot of $300-$400 headphones on the market right now, and most of them blur together. I spent the last few weeks with the Sennheiser Momentum 5 to determine if this pair actually stands out, testing everything from sound quality and noise cancellation to comfort and battery life. At $399.99, the Momentum 5 sit right in the middle of the premium headphone market. That puts them up against the pricier Sony WH-1000XM6 and Apple AirPods Max 2, while offering a more affordable option for anyone looking for high-end headphones. Deal: The Sennheiser Momentum 5 are currently discounted to $339.95 as part of Amazon’s Black Friday sale . Starting with sound, vocals sound natural and the bass is strong without taking over. The headphones allow you to start noticing little things in music, like a background harmony or a guitar string that cheaper headphones often tend to miss. If I had to describe the sound in one word, it’d be balanced . The headphones support Dolby Atmos, which essentially means that music or movies sound like they’re coming from all around you instead of just left and right. With this generation, Sennheiser doubled the microphone count to eight to improve the active noise cancellation (ANC). Voices and nearby chatter, which are usually the kind of sounds that can cut through weaker ANC, are noticeably quieter. Sennheiser claims this pair is up to three times more effective than the previous generation at blocking this type of noise. Of course, it’s not quite at the level of blocking out everything like a plane’s engine, but it does the job effectively without making your ears feel weirdly pressurized, as can be the case with some ANC headphones. As for comfort, the headphones aren’t as premium-feeling as Apple or Sony headphones that I’ve tried in the past, but given that the Momentum 5 costs less than its competitors, it’s a trade-off that’s hard to complain about. The battery life is genuinely impressive. It’s rated for up to 57 hours, and that figure held up in my testing. For context, that’s roughly twice the battery life of the Sony WH-1000XM6 and nearly three times that of the AirPods Max 2. And when the battery does run out, a 10-minute charge gets you up to seven hours of playback, while a full charge takes about two hours. A notable difference that the Momentum 5 offers that its competitors don’t is a user-replaceable cell, which means you can swap out the battery once it degrades instead of having to buy a whole new pair. What I wasn’t expecting, but found surprisingly useful, was how thin the carrying case is. I’ve never really been able to fit a pair of headphones into my medium-sized purses, but the Momentum 5 fit perfectly. It’s also a big plus when traveling, since the case doesn’t take up much space in your luggage.

articles.title: Figma employee sues, alleging company forced her to confront harassers | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Figma and its CEO are being sued by a current employee for alleged sexual harassment and discrimination.
articles.body_text: A Figma engineer is suing the design software company and its co-founder and CEO, Dylan Field, over allegations that she faced sexual harassment and retaliation while managers and HR repeatedly told her to confront the very people she accused of misconduct. The lawsuit, filed Monday in U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, alleges that Figma’s culture of “direct feedback” led managers and HR to make engineer Serry Park address harassment herself rather than investigate her complaints. Park, who joined Figma in 2022, alleges the company’s response damaged her career, compensation, and mental health. The lawsuit also alleges that Park, who is Asian, faced racial and gender discrimination, including performance criticism based on stereotypes that Asian women are meek, timid, and conflict-averse. “Figma was my dream company for a long time,” Park told TechCrunch in an interview before the lawsuit was filed. “It was a place where I felt that I could level up in my career, working on a lot of really cool, interesting things at scale.” Park is seeking damages, a jury trial, and a court order prohibiting Figma from requiring employees who report harassment to confront their alleged harassers. She also wants the company to adopt and enforce a process for investigating harassment complaints promptly and confidentially. When reached for comment, a spokesperson for Figma said, “Figma does not tolerate discrimination or harassment. Figma also does not tolerate extortion. These claims have no merit, and we will present the facts in court.” Park told TechCrunch she initially had faith in Figma’s complaint process, expecting that if she documented the alleged harassment and reported it to the right people, the company would act. But as an engineer in a male-dominated field, Park told TechCrunch, “I don’t feel that they took me seriously throughout this process.” Park, who is still employed at Figma, joined its San Francisco office in October 2022. Within weeks, her onboarding mentor — a fellow engineer — asked her on a date and continued pursuing her after she declined, Park alleges. She initially feared reporting him, worrying that her manager would “dismiss her reports or view her as the problem,” according to the lawsuit. Park says she tried to avoid her onboarding mentor. In early 2023, for example, she delayed choosing a work project until he had picked one. When her manager criticized her for not being a “team player,” Park explained that she was trying to avoid the colleague she accused of harassment, according to the suit. Her manager allegedly dismissed her concerns, saying he had “met his wife at work too” and treating the behavior as “harmless flirtation.” When Park asked to be kept off projects with the onboarding mentor, HR allegedly instructed her to confront him directly about his behavior. The lawsuit ties that response to Figma’s culture of direct feedback, which Park alleges Field established and enforced. It says the company’s People organization trains managers to direct employees, including those reporting harassment, to give feedback directly to the person involved. In March 2023, her manager assigned him to a major project she was leading, despite her request to be separated from him. Park told her manager that she would “figure it out,” but alleges that having to work with him affected her performance. Her manager gave her a 2 out of 5 on her performance review, criticizing her for not speaking up enough or engaging with others and for lacking presence. Park was put on a coaching plan, which she completed in late 2023. Changing managers didn’t help, according to the lawsuit. Her second manager also refused to separate them, allegedly telling Park that someone at her level should be able to resolve conflicts with teammates and that separating them would be “avoiding the problem.” Like her previous manager, he allegedly pointed out that he had met his partner at work.

articles.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes | TechCrunch
articles.summary: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.
articles.body_text: Anthropic is moving from having Claude write code to helping developers decide when that code is ready to ship. On Monday, the newly public AI company announced the launch of Claude Ship , a suite of AI agents for automating code reviews, fixes, and approvals of routine code changes. The latter is the more interesting part of this new set of tools, as AI coding tools already offered code review features before now. What’s notable about Claude Ship is not just that it can review proposed code changes and identify and address problems, but that it also includes an agent that can approve code changes automatically based on policies set by a development team. The launch arrives at a time when AI coding agents have become increasingly capable of generating substantial amounts of code, leading to bottlenecks in reviewing and approving the code changes before they go live. With Claude Ship, the idea is to automate even more of the work involved in the development process, essentially by delegating approval authority to an AI agent itself. “Most teams want a person to approve every change, and that’s easy to keep up with when people write every line. But a lot of developers build with agents now,” a company blog post explains. “On the Claude Code team, Claude writes most of our code, and we wanted everything after the PR to move that fast too.” Claude Ship is launching in beta, allowing early adopters to use it to review pull requests (PRs), and then decide what’s ready to merge. The new offering consists of Code Review, which is already generally available , and two new agents now in beta: PR Steward and Claude Approvals. PR Steward focuses on addressing issues such as failing CI checks, merge conflicts, and feedback from Code Review. It also comments after every push on what it changed and how to roll it back, if needed. Claude Approvals then applies an approval policy that the team writes as a file in the repository. This approval process can incorporate various signals, including Code Review findings or the company’s own classifiers, with policies written in natural language. Because the offering is still in beta, Anthropic suggests running the approval functionality in observe-only mode first. Teams can also choose to start with just one repository and set monthly spending limits to have more control over the process. Anthropic says teams will also still remain in control of where Claude Ship runs, which review settings to use (e.g., Quick, Standard, or Deep), and which changes should be escalated to a human for a decision. Claude Ship is rolling out to Claude Team and Enterprise plans for repositories on GitHub. Code Review is generally available, while PR Steward and Claude Approvals are in beta. articles.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal | TechCrunch
articles.summary: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.
articles.body_text: A handful of tech CEOs, including Elon Musk, are celebrating Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia. Despite being caught in three affairs — including one with an alleged Chinese spy that has triggered multiple congressional investigations over national security concerns — Huang was reinstated as CEO and president of Nvidia on Monday morning. “The mistake has been corrected,” Tesla and SpaceX leader Elon Musk wrote on X about Huang’s return. The mistake has been corrected https://t.co/UKvEng9rCD Musk had been among the most vocal tech leaders to advocate for Huang. “I think it’s like kicking Michael Jordan off your team when you’re on a winning streak, and it just doesn’t seem like a good thing for shareholders,” Musk said last week at the DealBook Summit. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman had taken a more neutral stance, commenting last week, “It’s hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen.” Altman had experienced a similar situation when he was ousted as CEO of OpenAI, then reinstated days later. After the announcement that Huang would return, Altman simply posted, “Jensen!” Many other tech CEOs have similarly refrained from commenting on the matter, given the shifting politics surrounding Huang’s ouster and reinstatement, as well as the national security concerns at the center of the controversy. In addition to Musk, Binance co-founder and former CEO Changpeng Zhao (CZ), who served prison time for failing to stop criminal activity on the Binance crypto exchange, is also supportive of Huang. “Glad to see @JensenHuang back,” CZ posted on X with a clapping hands emoji. Glad to see @JensenHuang back. 👏 https://t.co/WrUjvmEyVi Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, who had been among 200,000 signatories on an open letter calling for Huang’s reinstatement, wrote on X, “Jensen’s return will be a demonstration of American resiliency to corporate, political and journalistic missteps.” Another signatory on the open letter, former Uber CEO Travis Kalanick, who had similarly been driven out of the company he founded after scandals , also voiced his support for Huang on X.

articles.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.
articles.body_text: Megaspeed, the company that Alice Huang — the woman at the center of the alleged Chinese espionage scandal involving Nvidia — led for over two years, will be placed on a U.S. Commerce Department blacklist, Semafor reported Monday. The company will be added to the Commerce Department’s Entity List, the outlet writes. This list “contains the names of foreign parties” subject to certain export restrictions designed to ensure that “sensitive technologies do not fall into the hands of those who would threaten U.S. national security or American citizens.” Functionally, what this will mean is that U.S. companies will not be able to do business with or sell products to Megaspeed without first gaining a special license from the federal government. Semafor cites anonymous sources familiar with the matter to note the move is designed to stop the company “from obtaining US-made semiconductors.” Megaspeed is a Singapore-based cloud and AI infrastructure provider that, during the period that Nvidia’s boss, Jensen Huang, self-admittedly had an affair with Huang, was one of Nvidia’s biggest chip customers. Last week, the Commerce Department also announced it had launched a criminal probe into the company. Authorities in both the U.S. and Singapore are now probing whether the company defied export restrictions and illegally smuggled Nvidia chips to China . The company has denied wrongdoing. TechCrunch reached out to the Commerce Department for comment on the reporting and will update this story if it responds. After lobbying from President Trump, Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO on Monday after a short period in which he was ousted by the company’s board over the scandal involving Huang. articles.summary: Politicians on both sides of the aisle seem angry, agitated, and nonplussed by the return of Jensen Huang to Nvidia leadership less than two weeks after his ousting.
articles.body_text: Jensen Huang is back . The Nvidia CEO and founder, who was ousted from his company a little over a week ago after revelations of extramarital affairs (including, critically, a dalliance with a suspected Chinese spy ), has apparently been deemed too big to fail. Even if Huang is back for now, the Nvidia founder may face an uphill battle given the changing political landscape wrought by the “blue wave” of Democratic victories that swept the U.S. midterms. He is also expected to testify privately before several House committees next month, including the Intelligence Committee, the Foreign Affairs Committee, and the China Select Committee. articles.title: Amazon snaps up Decart's AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Amazon is acquiring Decart’s AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal.
articles.body_text: Amazon has agreed to acquire a good chunk of Israeli startup Decart. The e-commerce and cloud giant is paying $7.5 billion for the startup, according to Bloomberg. Decart has made a name for itself building interactive real-time world models — most recently Oasis 3 — and AI video-generation tools. But under the hood, the company stands out for its Decart Optimization Stack (DOS), software that helps AI models run efficiently on Nvidia, Amazon, and Google’s hardware. As part of the deal, Amazon will acquire the technology behind DOS, as well as Decart’s founding team and team of AI researchers and engineers, Amazon said in a blog post . “Every leap forward in AI starts with getting more out of every chip,” said Peter DeSantis, SVP of foundational AI models, custom silicon, quantum computing, at Amazon. “More efficient compute means better training, better reinforcement learning, faster inference, and better models for customers at a lower cost.” Amazon, which has so far been using its Trainium chips at its own data centers, is preparing to start selling them to customers as a competitor to Nvidia. Decart’s technology could make it easier for customers to run their workloads on Amazon chips, rather than Nvidia’s, which has been the gold standard so far.
